excerpt.zh: 我们开始了[target.GetName]的不可逆辐照过程，以此促进[target.GetToxifiedResourcesText]的生长并同时将其变为一片剧毒废土。
excerpt.en: We have begun the irreversible process of irradiating [target.GetName], promoting the growth of [target.GetToxifiedResourcesText] and turning it into a toxic wasteland in the process.

texts.zh: 我们开始了[target.GetName]的不可逆辐照过程，以此促进[target.GetToxifiedResourcesText]的生长并同时将其变为一片剧毒废土。
texts.en: We have begun the irreversible process of irradiating [target.GetName], promoting the growth of [target.GetToxifiedResourcesText] and turning it into a toxic wasteland in the process.

texts.zh:
我们在[target.GetName]上的首次地质辐射环境改造完成了。

将地表劣化为不可宜居的毒性废土，得益于而对地质辐射矩阵设计的改进，我们提取了数量庞大的资源。
texts.en:
Our first deployment of Georadiation Terraforming on [target.GetName] has concluded.

By reducing the surface to an uninhabitable toxic wasteland, we extracted an unprecedented bounty of materials thanks to our improvements to the Georadiation Matrix's design.

texts.zh: 这一里程碑事件标志着我国开始了一个开发和营利的新时代。
texts.en: This milestone marks the beginning of a new era of exploitation and profit for our empire.
